# BBL Injuries Florida — https://bblinjuries.com/

> Public-information index of Brazilian butt lift (BBL) lawsuits, medspa malpractice filings, injury cases, and mortality statistics in Florida, with Miami-Dade dockets first.

## Topics covered
- BBL lawsuit and wrongful-death cases (Miami, South Florida, statewide)
- Medspa and office surgery center malpractice
- Liposuction and gluteal fat grafting injuries
- Pulmonary fat embolism (PFE) risks and Florida Board of Medicine rules
- Links to court dockets, news, and peer-reviewed mortality studies

## Update frequency
Content JSON updated as new public filings and news are indexed.

## Contact / legal
Not a law firm. No client intake. Witness-notice context per Florida Bar advertising handbook.
